preserve: All Phase4/5 files and C16-KH v1 are read-only inputs

classifier.ancestry: purge train/validation chunks sharing original source-word blocks with held-out chunks; original classifier remains untouched

convergence.qualification: validation plateau; report literal final-checkpoint-best and recent trend; fewer than10% may remain improving at final cap; extend capped unfinished runs without restarting or test selection
convergence.selection: minimum raw validation BPT, never test; preserve curves and96-step results

C12_partial.selection: original Phase5 C12 rows only: mean squared standardized h2/word-W1/gain distances over clean and noise; rank ascending, tie by length then rigidity; collapse exact clean+noise data-equivalent settings before selecting two
C12_partial.fraction_unit: nested deterministic sets of atomic C5 sign types, including letters and sigla, following original C12 atomic-sign definition
C12_partial.realized_fraction: round(fraction*type_count), at least1; report type fraction and occurrence-weighted fraction
C12_partial.unselected_signs: retain atomic symbol; selected types use the original fixed codebook; count any resulting mixed-code word collisions
C12_partial.instrument: same T1 LSTM, baseline/position and five seeds as original sweep
C12_partial.status: exploratory post-0/36 follow-up; not confirmatory and excluded from classifier training

C16_KH_ranking_v2.input: preserved C16-KH v1 decoded lines and original LM; no key refit or lexicon substitution
C16_KH_ranking_v2.unknown_rule: omit UNK targets from score, retain original token history; exclude BOS/EOS from known-word mean
C16_KH_ranking_v2.score: mean original-LM log probability of known word targets
C16_KH_ranking_v2.selection: same per-source max over variants, equal-N comparisons and source-stripped shuffled blind export; no padding if insufficient eligible lines
C16_KH_ranking_v2.qualification: first verify held-out Hebrew and null calibration; preserve failure and do not treat a failed scorer as qualified on ZL
C16_KH_ranking_v2.blind: same clean Tanakh arm, target100ZL +25each null; independent sealed key, no self-ratings; export only genuinely eligible records
C16_KH_ranking_v2.preservation: hash v1 before/after; do not read its sealed key or modify concurrent c16-kh-scorer-v2 project
